# Godscar GitHub Copilot and coding-agent instructions

Read **[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)** and **[START-HERE.md](../../START-HERE.md)** first. This is the ACTIVE original browser game on `preview/browser`, not the unfaithful Godot rewrite on `main`. The player fights monsters automatically at all times while managing other systems.

Before coding: read project state, decisions, design intent, architecture, human-readable code standards, workflow and relevant actual source. Ask about materially unclear design direction and offer honest feasibility feedback. Write code a human can understand. After each change: update project state and changelog in the same commit; test, push, verify CI/deploy and leave an honest handoff. Don't touch Arcana.
